verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes an llms.txt at secureframe.com/llms.txt and a markdown rendition of its pricing page (pricing.md), both of which an agent can read directly. It also hosts agent-oriented MCP documentation at mcp.secureframe.com/mcp_docs that explains how AI assistants connect. Evidence for the llms.txt is limited to a single quoted line, so how much of the site it covers is unclear. Missing for 10: documentation of llms.txt structure and coverage (e.g. an llms-full.txt or a docs index), evidence of markdown versions across the docs, and independent or hands-on confirmation that agents consume these files well.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
